summary: Answered the owner's flood note on geography: a new map piece, MapWater, makes floods and seas roll in as waves with foam, ripples and a lapping shore, and the director must use it. The India map now shows Kerala as केरलम (Keralam), its official name since August 2026.
why: Owner notes come first (one open: v-20261125-12's flood was 'a shape and line'). im-keralam-label was a high-priority adopt item, confirmed by several outlets (the Act notified 25 Aug 2026). Both running tests (geo-claim-hook, doc-document-first) are on day 1 with 0 of 8 Shorts a side; tech, Disaster Desk and India Maps can't run a test at 1 Short a day or have no data.
